name: CLINDAMYCIN / KETOCONAZOLE 2/8 GR CREAM 30 GR 1 PIECE
description: The combination of clindamycin 2 g / ketoconazole 8 g in a 30 g vaginal cream is a medication used to treat mixed vaginal infections. Clindamycin acts as an antibiotic against bacteria, while ketoconazole is an antifungal that fights fungal infections. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
